name: Countdown Timer
author: Widgeter
description: Counts down to an event or date you choose, with a progress bar and a notification when time is up.

config.label: Event name
config.help: Leave empty (together with the date) to count down to the next New Year.

config.label: Date and time
config.help: Local time, written as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
